transformCandidates.conditionSql: SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) >= 1 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS CONDITION FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_NAME = 'PD_LDC_LATEST' AND COLUMN_NAME = 'NVM_NAMESPACE_ID'
transformCandidates.sql: WITH HG_AND_LDEV AS( SELECT DISTINCT PD_LHGC.COLLECTION_TIME, PD_LHGC.LDEV_NUMBER, PD_LHGC.HOST_GROUP_NAME FROM PD_LHGC JOIN PD_LDC_LATEST ON PD_LHGC.LDEV_NUMBER = PD_LDC_LATEST.LDEV_NUMBER WHERE PD_LDC_LATEST.NVM_NAMESPACE_ID IS NULL ) SELECT PD_VVC.DATETIME, PD_VVC.POOL_ID, CAST(SUM(PD_VVC.FREE_CAPACITY) / 1024 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS SUM_FREE_CAPACITY, CAST(SUM(PD_VVC.USED_CAPACITY) / 1024 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS SUM_USED_CAPACITY, CAST(SUM(PD_VVC.VIRTUAL_VOLUME_CAPACITY) / 1024 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS SUM_VIRTUAL_VOLUME_CAPACITY, CASE WHEN PD_PLC.POOL_NAME IS NULL THEN PD_PLC.POOL_ID ELSE PD_PLC.POOL_NAME END AS NULL_IGNORED_POOL_NAME, CONCAT( CASE WHEN PD_PLC.POOL_NAME IS NULL THEN '-' ELSE PD_PLC.POOL_NAME END, '(', PD_PLC.POOL_ID, ')' ) AS POOL_DISPLAY_NAME, HG_AND_LDEV.HOST_GROUP_NAME FROM PD_VVC JOIN PD_PLC ON PD_VVC.COLLECTION_TIME = PD_PLC.COLLECTION_TIME AND PD_VVC.POOL_ID = PD_PLC.POOL_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN HG_AND_LDEV ON PD_VVC.COLLECTION_TIME = HG_AND_LDEV.COLLECTION_TIME AND PD_VVC.LDEV_NUMBER = HG_AND_LDEV.LDEV_NUMBER WHERE PD_VVC.LDEV_NUMBER NOT IN (SELECT LDEV_NUMBER FROM PD_LDC_LATEST WHERE PD_LDC_LATEST.NVM_NAMESPACE_ID IS NOT NULL) GROUP BY PD_VVC.DATETIME, PD_VVC.POOL_ID, PD_PLC.POOL_NAME, HG_AND_LDEV.HOST_GROUP_NAME;

WITH HG_AND_LDEV AS( SELECT DISTINCT PD_LHGC.COLLECTION_TIME, PD_LHGC.LDEV_NUMBER, PD_LHGC.HOST_GROUP_NAME FROM PD_LHGC) SELECT PD_VVC.DATETIME, PD_VVC.POOL_ID, CAST(SUM(PD_VVC.FREE_CAPACITY) / 1024 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS SUM_FREE_CAPACITY, CAST(SUM(PD_VVC.USED_CAPACITY) / 1024 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS SUM_USED_CAPACITY, CAST(SUM(PD_VVC.VIRTUAL_VOLUME_CAPACITY) / 1024 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS SUM_VIRTUAL_VOLUME_CAPACITY, CASE WHEN PD_PLC.POOL_NAME IS NULL THEN PD_PLC.POOL_ID ELSE PD_PLC.POOL_NAME END AS NULL_IGNORED_POOL_NAME, CONCAT( CASE WHEN PD_PLC.POOL_NAME IS NULL THEN '-' ELSE PD_PLC.POOL_NAME END, '(', PD_PLC.POOL_ID, ')' ) AS POOL_DISPLAY_NAME, HG_AND_LDEV.HOST_GROUP_NAME FROM PD_VVC JOIN PD_PLC ON PD_VVC.COLLECTION_TIME = PD_PLC.COLLECTION_TIME AND PD_VVC.POOL_ID = PD_PLC.POOL_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN HG_AND_LDEV ON PD_VVC.COLLECTION_TIME = HG_AND_LDEV.COLLECTION_TIME AND PD_VVC.LDEV_NUMBER = HG_AND_LDEV.LDEV_NUMBER GROUP BY PD_VVC.DATETIME, PD_VVC.POOL_ID, PD_PLC.POOL_NAME, HG_AND_LDEV.HOST_GROUP_NAME;
